limitations.note: The agent fixed the RAM read-enable polarity but also changed when both Gray pointers update, shifting the observable full and empty timing that the reference fix preserves.
The test required the rewritten same-edge pointer update and used the DUT's own flags to count accepted transfers instead of independently checking the original cycle-by-cycle flag timing.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the simulation invocation to be rejected and resubmitted, after a failed Git check had already forced a separate invocation to locate Icarus.
The consulted guides covered other FIFO failure modes and did not help the agent isolate the read-enable fix from the asynchronous pointer timing.
